review:
Rotating Element reimagines a 5x5, 25-line grid with a Rotate symbol fixed in the centre. When conditions are met, it turns the whole grid 90° clockwise, shuffling every other symbol into new positions and creating fresh chances to win.

Symbols represent fire, water, wind and earth, with a flower as the scatter, framing an ecology and planetary theme. Free spins bring even more rotations, and therefore more wins. BGaming rates it medium-low volatility with a 5,000x maximum, and the RTP is an excellent 97.19%. Free spins arrive about once every 176 spins. A genuinely original mechanic.
pros: Excellent 97.19% RTP – among the highest published

Full game playable in the official free demo
